messages:
olivia: tiny weirdness -- Rollouts p99 for /v1/embeddings jumped to ~1.1s this morning but endpoint pane (per-host) stays ~340ms. p50/p95 match. anyone seen time-alignment causing surprises before?

samir: saw similar once. sometimes rollup uses event_time (when request started) and host pane uses ingest_time (when metric arrived). if there's a backfill or delayed batch, tails can look bigger in event-time windows.

zoe: that's a good hypothesis. our aggregator switched to event_time windows for more accurate SLOs last month; hosts still surface ingest_time by default for fast queries.

ingest-bot: ingestion job "agg-window-switch" completed 2026-02-12T06:12:00Z. aggregator.window_time=event_time; host_view.window_time=ingest_time.

samir: also check if the rollup's window is right-anchored vs host left-anchored. a 5m misanchor plus a delayed 200ms tail could skew p99 if event times cluster at the window edge.

olivia: console queries: rollup -> SELECT quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) FROM trace_rollups WHERE route='emb-v1' AND window='5m' /* uses event_time */; host pane -> SELECT quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(latency_ms) FROM host_traces WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND window='5m' /* ingest_time */ GROUP BY host_id

zoe: run a recompute using event_time on raw events and a recompute using ingest_time and compare. i can run both.

samir: quick UI fix: show the window anchor (event_time|ingest_time) next to the chart and a tooltip explaining the difference. + provenance tag for quantiles (merged-tdigest | raw-recompute | host-hist).

zoe: recompute results: raw-event_time-p99=1.08s; raw-ingest_time-p99=348ms; host hist p99=346ms; rollup (event_time) = 1.10s. so the rollup is consistent with event_time recompute.

olivia: that means delayed events (maybe retries or a slow cache warm) are showing up in event_time window but host ingest-time view hides them. which do we want the Rollouts pane to show? event_time is more correct for SLOs but surprises product folks.

samir: propose: default to event_time for SLO & rollouts, but add a small "time-anchor" toggle in the UI and a clear provenance pill: "time_anchor=event_time | quantile_source=merged-tdigest | sample_count=3.2k | sketch_size=64". also surface a short note when event_time vs ingest_time divergence >20% for p99.

zoe: operationally, we should add a nightly job that flags windows with large event/ingest deltas and summarises causes (backfills, retries, collector lag). file MET-4602 for that.

ingest-bot: ticket MET-4602 created: "Event vs Ingest time divergence audit" assigned to zoe.

olivia: temporary mitigation: i'll toggle Rollouts pane to ingest_time for the next 2h so PMs don't get noisy alerts while we add provenance. long term we'll default to event_time but teach the team. thanks all. :sparkles:
